extracted.intended_audience: general readers and readers interested in West African ethnography/colonial travel writing
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length, descriptive account of West African 'fetish' beliefs, rituals, spirits, and social customs written for a general/colonial readership; not a guideline or evaluative rubric but an ethnographic/travelogue narrative. Covers ceremonies, ordeals, spirit-types, and funerary practices.
